batch: 2026-09-14 New folder leachate, groundwater permit, laboratory and source-record reread
methods: All 12 PDFs were inventoried by filename, SHA-256, byte size and page count; filenames were not used as content labels.
All 109 pages were rendered at 120 DPI and inspected in page order, including tables, signatures, handwritten custody marks, maps and attachments.

OCR was applied to sparse laboratory COC/receipt pages (J17646 pp21-23; J19915 pp21-22) and Rule 2210 map/attachment pages 21-25; OCR readings were checked against page images and were not used to guess unreadable values.
Normalized page text and rendered-page comparisons were run against existing canonical records. Byte-distinct renditions remain provenance references without duplicate public records.
Reported statements, permit terms, analytical results, approvals, compliance listings and draft proposals remain distinct.

records.finding: DEQ's September 16, 2016 email transmits the final Wexford groundwater-discharge authorization and identifies the Rule 2210 permit as the attachment.
records.boundary: Transmittal only; not proof of a discharge or Cadillac receiving transaction.

records.finding: June 28, 2019 status reports Wexford as confirmed PFAS source, deep-well injection/no more leachate, June 4 effluent 2 MGD with PFOS 7.1 and PFOA 15 ng/L, influent NO, and source status PFOS eliminated.
records.boundary: Submitted status report and one effluent result; not zero-PFOS, removal-efficiency or final-load proof.

records.finding: December 18, 2019 status reports October 22 effluent 1.98 MGD with PFOS 2.4 and PFOA 3.4 ng/L, influent NO, no longer accepting leachate/deep-well injection, and current status Other: Trash.
records.boundary: The changed status wording is a report-state discrepancy, not an adjudicated reversal or dated cessation finding.

records.finding: September 8, 2009 minutes approve motion 2009.216 for a Wexford leachate-treatment agreement effective July 1, 2009-June 30, 2011, with reduced/sliding-rate language and Miscellaneous File 842; later pages concern test-well bids.
records.boundary: Minutes do not supply the executed agreement, signed rate schedule, invoices, individual loads or later renewals.

records.suppliedName: J17646-1 UDS Level 2 Report Final Report (Leachate)_2018.pdf
records.match: all 23 text/render pages equivalent; byte-distinct packaging
records.finding: TestAmerica job 190-17646-1 reports October 3, 2018 leachate PFOS 120/PFOA 590 ng/L primary (p5) and PFOS 140/PFOA 700 duplicate (p7); blanks are nondetect and dilution/matrix/QC qualifications are disclosed. COCs identify four samples received October 4 at 0.0 C.
records.boundary: Source characterization, not a truckload, WWTP influent, removal-efficiency or migration proof.

records.suppliedName: J19915-1 UDS Level 2 Report Final Report.pdf
records.match: same job/sample set and analytical content; raster/pagination rendition differs
records.finding: Eurofins/TestAmerica job 190-19915-1 reports June 4, 2019 primary effluent PFOS 7.8/PFOA 16 ng/L (p8) and duplicate PFOS 7.1/PFOA 15 (p9); blanks are nondetect and QC exceptions are disclosed. COCs/receipt identify work order 190-19915 and corrected receipt 3.9 C.
records.boundary: No influent, leachate, biosolids or groundwater sample; no removal-efficiency, source-causation or final-delivery conclusion.

records.match: all five text/render pages equivalent; byte-distinct packaging
records.finding: Draft November 20, 2017 City resolution opposes EPA injection-well permit MI-165-1I-0002 and states Cadillac treated over 14 million gallons of Wexford leachate in 2016 with capacity described as up to 20 million gallons/year; it lists reported contaminants.
records.boundary: Draft with blank vote/adoption fields; not proof of adoption, measured removal or an injection decision.

records.finding: DEQ pretreatment pre-inspection ID 57515 (completed May 13, 2015) identifies MI0020257. It records a February 3, 2011 equalization-tank observation of hauled County Landfill leachate, numerous historical ammonia/CBOD/pH/chronic-toxicity/fecal-coliform effluent rows, mercury/pretreatment/asset-management SOC entries, aging EQ concrete and recommendations for flow-proportioned sampling, metering and bar screening.
records.boundary: Historical listing, not a new enforcement adjudication, PFAS result or per-load ledger.

records.finding: Final GW1010342 permit issued September 6, 2016, effective October 1, 2016 and expiring January 31, 2017. It authorizes one-time diluted evaporator-lagoon leachate discharge up to 50,400 gpd/2,000,000 gpy by overland flow/spray bar, prohibits new leachate to the lagoon, sets EQ-1/U/V/W monitoring and Table I metals limits, and includes maps of the lagoon, hose, discharge area, wells, wetlands and topography.
records.boundary: Authorization terms, not proof of discharge or groundwater impact.

records.finding: DEQ/WRD states GW1010342 expired, authorized discharges were eliminated and completed, and terminates the permit July 2, 2018; a new permit is required before groundwater discharge resumes.
records.boundary: Permit-status determination, not a Cadillac final-load record.

records.suppliedName: Wexford Landfill Groundwater Discharge Permit Application 2210(y).pdf
records.finding: Submitted March 16, 2016 (2E2-C5H5-QVVF), the application proposes April-June aerated overland-flow discharge at 50,400 gpd/2,000,000 gpy, reports no wellhead-protection area, gives isolation distances and lists maps, flow worksheet and lagoon characterization attachments.
records.boundary: Application representations and attachment references, not measured discharge or hydrogeologic proof.

records.finding: Cadillac's SIU sheet lists Wexford County Landfill LLC, permit 590-13 mixed cells, 990 U.S. 131 N. and intermittent process wastewater at 33,000 gpd; process, category and attributed plant-problem fields are blank.
records.boundary: Aggregate SIU profile, not a per-load quantity, invoice, analytical result or PFAS causal finding.

verifiedFindings.finding: J17646-1 source chemistry and J19915-1 effluent chemistry create a documented source-to-monitoring sequence, but are different matrices/dates and do not quantify treatment removal or identify a load.
verifiedFindings.boundary: No mass balance or causal conclusion.

verifiedFindings.finding: June and December 2019 IPP forms document changing source-status language (PFOS eliminated versus Other: Trash) while both report deep-well injection/no more leachate.
verifiedFindings.boundary: Report-state discrepancy, not adjudicated reversal or dated cessation.

verifiedFindings.finding: Application, final permit and termination align on a one-time 50,400-gpd/2,000,000-gpy lagoon authorization and July 2, 2018 termination after DEQ stated authorized discharge was eliminated.
verifiedFindings.boundary: Receiving logs, invoices and final-load details remain open.
